note: The `remaining_length_* .byte_initialized_prefix_len` fields are semantic views over the vulnerable-original scalar `nread`: for the selected `Curl_read(conn, sockfd, (char *)&byte, 1, &nread)` call, `nread` is the number of bytes actually written into the one-byte local `byte`. The `*.byte_store_bytes` / `*.byte_read_bytes` fields are semantic views over `sizeof(byte)`, the width consumed by `pkt[mq->npacket++] = byte` and `byte & 0x80`. The `*.byte_addr` fields emit the address of that same vulnerable-original scalar `byte` as an alias witness for the transition assertions. The literal operand `remaining_length_guard.zero_literal` is intentionally omitted because `*.zero_literal` is treated as a compile-time constant.
